verdict.rationale: Moosend's own marketing documents on-brand reusable templates: a library of 130+ professionally designed, fully customizable templates that users brand with their own elements. It also claims dynamic content, which loosely implies personalization. The rest of the story rests only on thin homepage claims. Missing for 10: explicit visual or drag-and-drop editor evidence, documented personalization tokens or merge tags, cross-client rendering or testing evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can design on-brand emails with a visual editor, reusable templates, and personalization tokens that render correctly across clients

citations.quote: Browse our growing library of 130+ professionally-designed templates, pick the one that matches your goal, and add your brand’s elements to make it yours.
let your brand stand out with fully customizable templates.
Hook your audience with dynamic content and AI-powered suggestions.
